description: Every Flighty Airports meltdown map feature, plus cross-airport intelligence no web page can answer.

novel_features.name: Worst-airports ranking
novel_features.description: Rank the network's airports right now by cumulative delay and cancellations — the web map color-codes but never ranks.

novel_features.name: Flight lookup by number
novel_features.description: Find one flight by number across arrivals and departures boards — status, original vs actual time, gate, belt, terminal.

novel_features.name: Network airline disruption
novel_features.description: One airline's delay/cancel/divert footprint aggregated across every synced airport — impossible per-airport on the site.

novel_features.name: Airport comparison
novel_features.description: Side-by-side status, delays, warnings, and flight rules for two airports.

novel_features.name: Route disruption check
novel_features.description: Both directions of one origin-destination pair's delay/cancel/divert stats, joined from each side's disrupted routes.

novel_features.name: Healthy-alternates finder
novel_features.description: Distance-ranked nearby airports, flagging which have normal operations right now.

novel_features.name: Change diff since last sync
novel_features.description: What changed since the last sync: status transitions, new/cleared warnings, delay deltas.
